behaviour: agentihooks ci-lab-worker answers each GET /metrics scrape with ci_lab_node_mirror_age_seconds labelled with the node name from CI_LAB_NODE_NAME: the seconds from the epoch second in the node cache's fetched-at stamp under CI_LAB_GIT_MIRROR to the scrape's wall clock, never below zero, with no sample while the stamp is missing or holds no whole number; a worker without a node name exports no mirror age sample, even when the stamp exists. A bad stamp drops only the node gauge's sample, never another series, and the scheduler's unlabelled ci_lab_mirror_age_seconds keeps its own reading. The worker's metrics server runs its observers before each 200 answer of /metrics and for no 404 or 405.
seam: scripts.ci_lab.executors main serving the worker registry through scripts.ci_lab.metrics serve_registry and expose with observe callables, scripts.ci_lab.metrics observe_mirror with a node name, and the scripts.ci_lab.contract node gauge and node name
